notes: The italic *the people* is a supplied lexical subject answering to no source nominal and is added under rule 17; תְּרוּמָה is rendered as the object *the oblations*.
עַד־לָרוֹב fuses to *plenty* (rule 30), and both articles of הֶהָמוֹן הַזֶּה are unrepresented, the phrase's one determiner being the demonstrative's (rule 41).
הַכֹּהֵן הָרֹאשׁ is rendered prenominally, so the first article takes the single *the* and the agreement article is unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
